content: When tested in rats, cefditoren pivoxil at oral doses up to 1000 mg/kg/day, which is approximately 24 times the human dose of 200 mg twice daily based on mg/m²/day, did not affect fertility or reproduction. There is limited information available regarding clinical studies of cefditoren in the drug label. Cefditoren pivoxil tablets are available in two strengths, containing cefditoren pivoxil equivalent to either 200 mg or 400 mg of cefditoren. These tablets are white, elliptical, film-coated, and imprinted with “CBP 200” or “CBP 400” in blue. They are supplied in blister packages as follows: NDC 44009-802-20: 400 mg, 20-count blister pack. NDC 44009-802-28: 400 mg, 28-count blister pack. NDC 44009-801-20: 200 mg, 20-count blister pack. There is limited information provided in the drug label regarding the storage conditions for cefditoren. Patients should be counseled that antibacterial drugs, including cefditoren pivoxil, should only be used to treat bacterial infections. They are not effective against viral infections (e.g., the common cold). When prescribed cefditoren pivoxil for a bacterial infection, patients should be informed that although they may feel better early in the course of therapy, the medication must be taken exactly as directed. Skipping doses or failing to complete the full course of therapy may: 1. Reduce the effectiveness of the immediate treatment. 2. Increase the likelihood that bacteria will develop resistance, making them untreatable by cefditoren pivoxil or other antibacterial drugs in the future. Cefditoren pivoxil should be taken with meals to enhance absorption. It may be taken concomitantly with oral contraceptives. However, it is not recommended to take cefditoren pivoxil with antacids or other drugs that reduce stomach acid. Cefditoren pivoxil tablets contain sodium caseinate, a milk protein. Patients with hypersensitivity to milk protein (not lactose intolerance) should not be administered cefditoren pivoxil. The interaction between alcohol and cefditoren has not been established. Patients should consult their doctor regarding the effects of consuming alcohol while taking this medication.
